data.long_meaning: From the Latin word "baldo", meaning 'bold or brave'. The name Baldovino also contains the suffix "-ino", which means 'little' or 'young one'. This name was commonly given to young boys in the Middle Ages who showed great courage and bravery. The name Baldovino carries the meaning “Brave friend” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Baldovino usually hope their child will grow to embody brave friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
